overview.en: Macrophyllum macrophyllum is a small leaf-nosed bat of the Americas.
overview.fr: Macrophyllum macrophyllum est une petite chauve-souris à feuille nasale des Amériques.

identification.en: Long hind limbs and tail set it apart from similar small bats.
identification.fr: Ses longues pattes arrière et sa queue le distinguent de petites chauves-souris proches.

habitat.en: It roosts near water in forests, caves, culverts and tunnels.
habitat.fr: Il se repose près de l’eau, en forêt, dans des grottes, buses et tunnels.

diet.en: It eats mainly insects, including flying and aquatic species; fish hunting is unconfirmed.
diet.fr: Il mange surtout des insectes volants et aquatiques ; la pêche n’est pas confirmée.

behavior.en: Echolocation guides its fluttering flight over water.
behavior.fr: L’écholocation guide son vol papillonnant au-dessus de l’eau.

reproduction.en: Females give birth to one young; breeding-season data are sparse.
reproduction.fr: Les femelles donnent naissance à un seul petit ; la saison de reproduction est mal documentée.

ecology.en: It may affect local populations of aquatic insects.
ecology.fr: Il peut influer sur les populations locales d’insectes aquatiques.

conservation.en: Animal Diversity Web reports the global IUCN category as Least Concern. Argentina's 2019 assessment classified it as Data Deficient nationally.
conservation.fr: Animal Diversity Web rapporte la catégorie mondiale de l’UICN « préoccupation mineure ». L’évaluation argentine de 2019 l’a classée « données insuffisantes » dans ce pays.

title.en: Macrophyllum macrophyllum — Animal Diversity Web, University of Michigan
title.fr: Macrophyllum macrophyllum — Animal Diversity Web, Université du Michigan

facts: Summarizes the bat's distribution, distinctive hind limbs, diet, echolocation, surface gleaning and the few known birth records.
Stomach remains indicate mostly insect prey and do not support the presumed fish-eating habit.

title.en: Macrophyllum macrophyllum — Argentine mammal conservation assessment (SAREM, 2019)
title.fr: Macrophyllum macrophyllum — évaluation de la conservation des mammifères d’Argentine (SAREM, 2019)

facts: The Argentine national assessment is summarized as Data Deficient; this is a national category, not a global assessment.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

uncertainties: Natural-history and reproductive observations remain sparse. The sources report assessments at different geographic scales, so the Argentine Data Deficient category should be read alongside, not substituted for, the global category.
review_note: Cross-checked an English university species account with Spanish-language regional mammal references; kept the conservation category explicitly national.
